title: Compact regional routing runtime and graceful degradation protocol
creator: Alicia Moreno
description: Current smart routing exhibits duplicated fallback signaling, heavyweight per-region state, and lock contention in the decision hot path. This ticket refactors the regional routing runtime to a compact state machine and introduces a unified "graceful degradation" protocol that standardizes fallback handshakes across controllers. Work includes: reclaiming 3-4ms average tail latency by removing global mutexes in the route evaluator, collapsing redundant route leases into a single lease object per shard, normalizing circuit-breaker semantics for cross-region requests, and upgrading the routing protobuf and gRPC libraries to the latest non-breaking minor to unlock new stream handling primitives. We'll also add a lightweight in-memory decision cache with bounded TTL to reduce evaluator traffic for repeated short-lived requests. The goal is to reduce p99 latency and failure bounce when a region is experiencing transient capacity pressure while keeping rollback/rollout simple.
acceptance_criteria: Unit and integration tests for new graceful-degradation protocol
P99 serving latency improvement >= 15% on synthetic regional failover workload
Telemetry: new metrics for fallback handshake latency and lease churn
All existing high-level routing feature flags toggle to original behavior
No regression in regional route affinity tests (end-to-end)
risks: Upgrading gRPC/protobuf could require minor message shape adjustments
Cache TTL misconfiguration could introduce stale routing decisions
Incorrect lease consolidation may surface race conditions under high churn
rollout_plan: Feature-flag guarded merge: default OFF in canary region
Canary run for 72 hours on us-west-2 with traffic shaping to simulate capacity pressure
Monitor fallback-handshake and lease-churn dashboards; gradual ramp to 25% then 100%
Automatic rollback on spike in fallback rate or error budget burn
qa_steps: Run local integration harness with simulated regional outages
Replay captured routing traces through new state machine
Benchmarks: compare old vs new evaluator under 10k RPS workload
Run chaos-engineering job that kills regional capacity and verify graceful degradation
